tools.name: plugin_file_manager_status
tools.description: Check whether the plugin has Android all files access and report the managed storage root.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_open_all_files_access_settings
tools.description: Open Android all files access settings for the File Manager Plugin.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_list
tools.description: List files or folders in one directory under the managed external storage root after all files access is granted. Results may be limited; this does not recursively list the whole tree.

path.description: Relative path under the external storage root. Use an empty string for the root.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_search
tools.description: Recursively search file and folder names under a relative external-storage directory. This does not search file contents.

directory.description: Relative directory under the external storage root. Use an empty string for the root.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_read_text
tools.description: Read a complete text file under the managed external storage root only if its size does not exceed maxBytes. Oversized files are rejected, not partially read.

path.description: Relative file path under the external storage root.

maxBytes.description: Whole-file size limit in bytes. Default and hard maximum: 1048576 (1 MiB).

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_create_file
tools.description: Create a new text file under external storage. Existing files are not overwritten.

content.description: Initial text content, default empty string.

createParents.description: Whether to create missing parent folders. Default true.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_write_text
tools.description: Create or replace the complete text content of a file under external storage. Existing files require overwrite=true; this does not append.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file. Default false.

createParents.description: Whether to create missing parent folders. Default true.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder under external storage.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_rename
tools.description: Rename one file or folder under external storage.

path.description: Relative source path under external storage.

newName.description: New file or folder name only, not a path.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing target. Default false.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_batch_rename_preview
tools.description: Preview batch rename changes and return a previewToken. This tool does not mutate files.

directory.description: Relative directory containing files to rename.

namePattern.description: Pattern with {index}, {name}, and optional {ext}, for example vacation_{index}{ext}.

includeDirectories.description: Whether folders should also be renamed. Default false.

limit.description: Maximum entries to preview, default 50, clamped to 1..500.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_batch_rename_apply
tools.description: Apply a previously previewed batch rename. The previewToken from preview is required.

directory.description: Relative directory containing files to rename.

startIndex.description: Same first index value used in preview.

padding.description: Same padding width used in preview.

includeDirectories.description: Same includeDirectories value used in preview.

limit.description: Same maximum number of entries used in preview.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one file or folder under external storage. Direct deletion has no recycle bin. Folders require recursive=true; the storage root cannot be deleted.

recursive.description: Must be true to delete a folder. Default false.

tools.name: plugin_file_manager_download
tools.description: Download an HTTPS URL to a relative path under external storage.

path.description: Relative destination path under external storage.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing destination file. Default false.

maxBytes.description: Maximum download bytes. Default and hard maximum: 104857600 (100 MiB).
